metric signature, action sign, kinetic sign, and boundary policy declared
full_scalar_disablement primary switch with disabled, held, quarantined, and out-of-scope terms
V(Psi), dV_dPsi, and leakage handling declared as symbolic hold or explicit refusal
exact, structural, or symbolic correspondence rule written before execution
provenance and source-role metadata available for the baseline and fixture inputs

If B_Psi lacks a separate definition artifact, keep B_Psi demoted.
If Journey/Solas is cited, keep it journey_context_not_canon.
